Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) cause for serious concern is building
If you’ve read my iPhone XR Vs iPhone XS and Vs iPhone XS Max guides, you’ll know that it is actually Apple AAPL +1.47%’s new budget-friendly XR which is by far the most exciting model this year. But now the iPhone XR is finally available to buy, something appears very wrong…
On Friday respected Loup Ventures analyst Gene Munster expressed his surprise that the iPhone XR was the first new iPhone in generations not to sell out within hours of going on sale. But now it’s much worse.
Some clarity may arrive early next month as Apple is due to report its next financial quarter on November 1st. The company never breaks down iPhone sales by model, but (*refreshes pages, finds all iPhone XR models still available day one*) cause for serious concern is building…

Momentum is a general term used to describe the speed at which prices move over a given time period. Generally, changes in momentum tend to lead to changes in prices. This expert shows the current values of four popular momentum indicators.
Stochastic Oscillator
One method of interpreting the Stochastic Oscillator is looking for overbought areas (above 80) and oversold areas (below 20). The Stochastic Oscillator is 59.3801. This is not an overbought or oversold reading. The last signal was a buy 5 period(s) ago.
Relative Strength Index (RSI)
The RSI shows overbought (above 70) and oversold (below 30) areas. The current value of the RSI is 48.29. This is not a topping or bottoming area. A buy or sell signal is generated when the RSI moves out of an overbought/oversold area. The last signal was a sell 31 period(s) ago.
Commodity Channel Index (CCI)
The CCI shows overbought (above 100) and oversold (below -100) areas. The current value of the CCI is -52. This is not a topping or bottoming area. The last signal was a buy 0 period(s) ago.
MACD
The Moving Average Convergence/Divergence indicator (MACD) gives signals when it crosses its 9 period signal line. The last signal was a sell 9 period(s) ago.
